name: RentCast Irvine AI Property Recommendations Email
description: Fetch active Irvine sale listings from RentCast, analyze listings with OpenAI, write AI-enriched rows into cx_property, then email customer recommendations through Gmail.

nodes.name: Schedule
nodes.notes: Run manually or daily for fresh Irvine active sale listings.

nodes.name: RentCast Irvine Sale Listings
nodes.notes: Fetch active for-sale listings in Irvine, CA from RentCast. Requires RENTCAST_API_KEY in the backend environment.

nodes.name: OpenAI GPT-5 Property Analyst
nodes.notes: Analyze each RentCast listing using address, price, market signals, and price-cut data. Returns rows with ai_* fields plus an email summary.

integrationSettings.promptTemplate:
Analyze up to 3 Irvine home listings. Use only the JSON below. For each listing, return short buyer guidance, not legal/tax/mortgage advice.

For each row return only: id, ai_score 1-100, ai_summary, ai_strengths, ai_weaknesses, ai_risks, ai_recommended_buyer_profile.

Also write one customer email summarizing the best listings.

Listings JSON:
{{previous_step}}
integrationSettings.dataPolicy: Use listing data only; no sensitive customer PII beyond configured recipient email; AI output is buyer guidance, not legal, tax, mortgage, or appraisal advice.

nodes.name: CellX Bulk Import AI Properties
nodes.notes: Write OpenAI-enriched listing rows into the CellX cx_property table.

nodes.name: JSON Transform
nodes.notes: Extract OpenAI email subject/body and customer summary for Gmail.

nodes.name: Gmail
nodes.notes: Send OpenAI-generated property recommendations to customer email recipients.

nodes.name: CellX Query Property Clients
nodes.notes: Read real estate client names and email addresses from cx_property_clients before sending recommendations.

integrationSettings.whereClause: del_flag = '0' AND email IS NOT NULL AND email <> ''

nodes.name: Write History Log
nodes.notes: Append an audit event after the AI property recommendation email workflow runs.
